outbound_email.subject: Dr Test Grantparity AHPRA registration approved, next step is the visa
outbound_email.bodyText:
Hi there,

Wonderful news. AHPRA has approved Dr Test Grantparity’s specialist registration. The registration number is MED0001234567 and it is effective from 2 November 2026. It stays current until 30 September 2027.

The registration is granted with conditions, which we will walk through with Dr Grantparity.

The next step is the visa. Could you please engage a registered migration agent to prepare the Subclass 482 nomination for Test Regional Practice (FAKE) and lodge Dr Grantparity’s visa? Once you have chosen the agent, simply reply to this email with their name and email address and we will connect them with Dr Grantparity and share the documents they need.

The visa must be granted before Dr Grantparity can start, so the sooner the agent is engaged the more room there is in the timeline.

One thing to note for later: AHPRA asks for supervision reports at three months and six months after commencement. We will remind you closer to the time.

Thank you for everything so far. We are delighted to have reached this milestone with you.

Warm regards,
The GP Link team
GP Link

email.subject: Congratulations Dr Grantparity, your AHPRA registration is approved
email.title: Congratulations, {{name}}!
email.body:
AHPRA has approved your specialist registration. Your registration number is MED0001234567 and it is effective from 2 November 2026.

What happens next

Test Regional Practice (FAKE) is engaging a registered migration agent to sponsor your Subclass 482 visa. The agent prepares the nomination with the practice and lodges the visa. You do not need to lodge anything yourself.

What we need from you now

Please upload a clear colour scan or photo of the passport photo page for you, your partner and your 2 children:

• Your passport
• Partner's passport
• Child 1 passport
• Child 2 passport

Use the passport each person will travel on. You can upload these on your visa page in the app, it only takes a minute.

If your family situation has changed since you told us who is moving with you, just reply to this email and I will update the request.

Warm regards,
The GP Link team
GP Link
